Select IC50 activities against human Pim-1 kinase. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary to capture publication provenance and assay metadata. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter for target name 'Pim-1 kinase' and organism 'Homo sapiens', and standard_type 'IC50'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Do not sort.
